First you need the recipe. It turns up rarely in the chests of a dungeon's strongest foes. Read it once and you know it for good.
To brew it, use an alchemy lab, then say /brew revive while you stand there. It takes two measures of wheat, one of troll fat and one salt pile.
A draught is only used up when it raises someone.

sections.heading: Jails and prisons
items: Every jail and prison is now a working jail: Skyrim's town jails and Cidhna Mine, Bruma's and Kvatch's castle dungeons, the Imperial City jail, Windhelm's prison, Baan Malur, Fort Tulis, and DragonBreak's own prisons.

Guards and hold officials can lock a player in a cell. Use the cell door with them close by, choose their name, then a sentence from 5 minutes to 2 hours. The door closes and stays locked until the time is served.
Your time only counts while you are online and inside the jail. Logging out does not count, and neither does time spent outside after an escape.
When your time is up you are told, and the door unlocks. Type /sentence to see how much is left.
Anyone with a lockpick can try a locked cell door. The Lockpicking skill improves your odds, and a failed attempt breaks the pick.
/unstuck does not work inside a jail, or anywhere while you still have time to serve.

sections.heading: Beds and inns
items: Rent a bed at an inn by using it: 10 gold for 24 hours. The rent goes to the inn's owner, with a tenth to the hold; an inn nobody owns pays it all to the hold. In Bruma, try the Jerall View Inn or the Restful Watchman.
A rented bed is yours alone until the rent runs out. Anyone else who tries it is told who has it and until when.
A bed in a house you own works the same way, with no rent to pay.
Choose Sleep to log out. Stay away at least 30 minutes and you wake Well Rested, with health that recovers faster, and Well Fed, with hunger coming on at half speed. Both last 2 hours.
Type /rest to see how long both have left.

sections.heading: Falling in battle
items: A player who falls is now down, not dead. You lie where you fell for 60 seconds before waking at the temple, and a banner tells you so.
Only a Priest of the fourth tier can raise the fallen: cast Healing Hands or Heal Other on them, or Grand Healing with them close by. They get up where they lay with a quarter of their health.
Someone who fought you in the last minute cannot raise you.
Tired of waiting? Type /respawn to wake at the temple at once.
A hostile player can finish off someone who is down, sending them to the temple. Creatures and bandits leave the fallen alone.
Alchemists will soon be able to brew a potion that raises the fallen.

sections.heading: Friendly fire
items: Party members, and their summons and companions, now take a fifth of the damage from each other. A stray sword or fireball can no longer kill a friend outright.

sections.heading: Summons and companions
items: The companion panel no longer keeps showing a summon after it dies or its time runs out.
A summon told to attack something it cannot reach no longer stands still until you leave the area. Once you are far enough away, it gives up and comes back to you.

sections.heading: Messages
items: Important messages, such as an ability that is not ready yet, now appear across the middle of your screen instead of only in chat.
When a character's life ends for good, you now see it and are returned to the menu, where that character is marked as dead.

sections.heading: Launcher
items: The launcher downloads one small new file, DragonBreak Nexus Patches. It carries changes the server already made to a few mods (crafting recipes and notice boards), so your game now matches the server exactly.

sections.heading: Werewolves and Vampire Lords
items: Beast forms finally work for everyone around you. Until now the server never learned a beast spell, so your drains, summons, bats and howls did nothing to anyone else. They all land now.
When you change, the chat lists every ability and the key for it. Type /forms to see it again.

Keys 1 to 9 choose your abilities without a menu. As a Vampire Lord, 1 to 4 pick the spell in your left hand (Raise Dead, Corpse Curse, Summon Gargoyle, Vampire's Grip) and 5 to 9 pick the power on your Shout key (Bats, Mist Form, Supernatural Reflexes, Detect Life, Revert Form). As a werewolf, 1 and 2 pick your howl.
Claws hit much harder: a werewolf's swipe does about 50 and a Vampire Lord's about 35, double on a power attack.
Sneak drops a Vampire Lord to the ground to fight with his claws, hands empty, and lifts him back into the air for spells.
Vampiric Drain no longer takes a whole health bar in one hit.
The Vampire Lord now wears Harkon's royal robes and cape.
Your menus come back when you change back. They used to stay locked until you restarted the game.
Seeing a Vampire Lord should no longer crash the people around him.

sections.heading: Magic
items: Ash Rune now encases whoever steps on it in ash for 30 seconds, as it should.

sections.heading: Dungeons
items: Ebony and Daedric gear, and Ebony ingots, no longer turn up in dungeon chests or on the dead.
Lakeside Retreat is no longer a dungeon.

sections.heading: Argonians
items: An Argonian's tail and feet now match the rest of the body. They were wearing an older skin that did not match.

sections.heading: Bruma
items: New work across the city of Bruma: new pieces placed, others cleared away, and changes to the land, several interiors and two townsfolk routines. Your launcher downloads the updated plugin on its next start.

sections.heading: Choosing a character
items: The Play button was below the bottom of the panel once you had a few characters, so the only way to start the game was to scroll down for it. The panel is now a fixed frame: the title and Play stay put and only the list of characters scrolls.
The letter in each character's diamond was lying on its side, and the + on an empty slot came out looking like an x. Both sit upright now.
The pale scrollbar down the side of the panel is gone, replaced by a thin one that matches the rest of the interface.
Quitting to the main menu brings the character screen back up. It was meant to already, but a quirk of how the game reloads meant the request was never sent.

sections.heading: Notice boards
items: The N key no longer opens a notice board, because walking up to one and pressing E has worked on every board since the hold fix. N is free for something else, and it is gone from the launcher's hotkey settings.

title: Your Size, Your Voice, Your Keys

sections.heading: Resize anything
items: Every panel can now be sized on its own: hold Ctrl and turn the mouse wheel over it. That includes your vitals and the voice indicator (release the mouse first to reach them). Ctrl and middle click puts a panel back.
The launcher has an Interface size setting for everything at once, and a button that resets every panel.

sections.heading: Voice
items: A new Voice tab in the launcher: pick your microphone and speakers, set how loud you sound and how loud others are, and choose push to talk or voice activation with a live meter.
Face a player and press X to make their voice louder, quieter, or mute it. It is remembered on your PC.
Voice chat itself switches on as soon as its server is reachable; we will announce it.

sections.heading: Hotkeys
items: Every in-game key can now be changed in the launcher, including Interact, Mask, Voice Range, Skills, Bounty Board, Emote Wheel and Nametags.

sections.heading: Stamina
items: Power attacks now cost stamina. They never did: the whole table of stamina costs for attacking was switched off on this server by a flag meant for a different server, so nothing you did with a weapon ever drained the bar.
A power attack costs 30 of your 100 stamina, so three of them empty you. Ordinary swings, jumping and drawing a bow still cost nothing.

sections.heading: Launcher 2.1.27
items: Fixes a crash about twenty seconds into launch, before the main menu, for anyone who owns Creation Club content. The game was choking on its Creations catalogue; the launcher now moves that file aside before starting, keeping a copy.
The previous version only cleared part of it, which is why the crash came back.

sections.heading: Shock spells
items: Every shock spell was hitting for about 200 points more than it should. Sparks was landing 208 damage a tick instead of 8, Lightning Bolt 225 instead of 25, Chain Lightning 240 instead of 40 and Lightning Storm 275 instead of 75, which killed most people outright.

The cause: shock spells carry a hidden effect for the Disintegrate perk whose magnitude of 200 is a health threshold, not damage, and the server was adding it to the spell's damage. Fire and frost were never affected, which is why only shock felt broken.
Shock now deals its normal damage. Nothing else in the game changed: the rule was checked against all 1,800 spells in the load order and exactly eleven shock spells moved.

sections.heading: Magicka
items: Your magicka pool goes from 100 to 150. At 100 an adept spell could not be cast at all, because Fireball alone costs about 133. Health and stamina are unchanged, so nothing about enemy damage changes with it.

sections.heading: Looting the dead
items: A dead player's body no longer hands over everything they were carrying. Whoever searches it first takes two random things and a fifteenth of their coin, and the body is spent after that. House keys are never taken.
Everything left on the body comes back with the player when they rise.

sections.heading: Interface
items: The interface now scales to your screen. On a 1440p or 4K display every panel was drawn at the size it would be on a 1080p monitor, which made it tiny; it is now sized to match. Nothing gets smaller than it was.
Property keys are named after the property. A key now reads "Key to the Jerall View Inn" instead of carrying a form id in brackets. Keys you already hold still work.

sections.heading: Admin panel
items: Teleport no longer hides anything. It used to stop at 250 rows, which left 341 places in Skyrim reachable only by guessing their name; the list now pages through everything and groups by worldspace under the region chips.

Half the teleport points were named after map coordinates ("Solstheim World 11,11") because the game keeps those names in a separate table the tools were not reading. They read them now: 376 nameless points became 2, and the two that are left genuinely have no name.
Item names came out of the same table, so "cc BGSSSE025 Amber Battleaxe" is now "Amber Battleaxe" and "Favor Amren Iron Sword" is "Amren’s Family Sword".
Skills, Items and Powers share one dropdown of yourself and everyone online instead of three boxes you typed a name into.
Delete character, IP ban and temp ban ask once before they fire.

sections.heading: Beast forms
items: Granting Beast Form or Vampire Lord from the admin panel did not let anyone change shape, and nothing said why. The panel can now Grant the power, Transform, Revert and Revoke directly, for werewolf and Vampire Lord both, and it shows which of the two a character holds and what shape they are in.
Any refusal to change shape now says what stopped it, in chat and in the log, instead of nothing happening.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Fire burns vampires and silver bites werewolves again. The extra damage was being worked out and then thrown away before it reached the target.

sections.heading: Combat
items: Enemy weapon and claw hits on players now land at twice the damage. Enemy spells are unchanged; they were already where they should be.

sections.heading: Property
items: Houses, shops and containers are no longer claimed by whoever walks up to them. A hold's Jarl, Steward or Chieftain (or an admin) claims a property and grants it to a player from the same menu. Existing owners keep what they hold.

sections.heading: Beast forms
items: Casting Beast Form or Vampire Lord no longer locks your controls: the game's own change is cancelled at once and the server does the transformation.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: The Rise button in prayer closes the window after the shrine has answered.

sections.heading: Vitals
items: Everyone starts sturdier: base health is up by 100, magicka and stamina by 50, for every race. Racial differences stay on top of that.

sections.heading: Beast forms
items: Beast Form and Vampire Lord work: cast the power, or type /beast (and /beast revert). The power must have been granted to you.
Werewolves of the pack and holders of the Blood Crown have their forms without an admin grant.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Shooting a bow no longer unequips your arrows.

Fixed a crash before the main menu for players who had used the Bethesda Creations menu: the game choked on its cached Creations list. The launcher now clears that cache at every launch. DragonBreak never uses that content.
Free Nexus accounts can now let the launcher download mods: click Mod Manager Download on the Nexus page and the launcher fetches the file for you. No more moving zips by hand.
Sign in to Nexus in the launcher first, keep it open, and press PLAY when the download list is done.
Only one launcher window runs at a time.

title: Stuck on the Main Menu No More

items: Creating a character no longer leaves some players on the main menu. If you ever used Vortex, its save-folder setting had been copied into the DragonBreak profile; the launcher now resets it at every launch.
Leftover plugin force-load lines from other launchers are removed from the profile, so your load order always matches the server.
The install window no longer shows Not Responding while the client files unpack.
Settings > Repair has a Copy Log button, and the log text can be selected. Paste it in Discord when you ask for help.
Settings > Repair: Disable DragonBreak Files removes our plugins, archives and assets from the game copy so it can join other servers. PLAY or Enable puts them back.
Settings > Repair: Uninstall removes the whole DragonBreak install after a confirmation. Your Steam copy and launcher settings stay.
Check Files no longer stops with an error.
The modlist panel links to the full DragonBreak collection on Nexus.
Check Files no longer reports DragonBreak Online Edits.esp as corrupt: the client package now carries the same copy the game server runs.
Log files a mod writes into its own folder are no longer flagged as stray files.
A plugins.txt rewritten by Mod Organizer is only noted; the launcher restores the server order at every launch.
The STATS window shows the world clock: the hour, the date and the phase of the moons, with a moon that fills and wanes.
A full moon is marked. Werewolves, plan your nights.
It also shows the weather over Bruma and how fast the day turns.

title: Blood and Moonlight
body: Vampirism and lycanthropy come to DragonBreak, and the world now keeps one clock for everyone.

sections.heading: One world, one sky
items: Time of day, the date and the moons are the same for every player. A game day passes every four real hours.
Weather is shared too: if it snows over Bruma, it snows for everyone there.
/time tells you the hour, the date and the moons.

sections.heading: Vampires
items: A vampire's blows can pass Sanguinare Vampiris. You have three days to cure it with a Cure Disease potion or a prayer.
When the fever peaks you face the Blood Fever. Survive it and you rise a vampire; fail and it takes you.
Stages grow each day you go unfed: the sun burns harder and fire bites deeper. Feed on a restrained foe or a fresh corpse to reset.
Molag Bal's Embrace, at his shrine, makes a pure-blood of those who survive it. Some never wake.
The Blood Crown: one pure-blood holds the Vampire Lord form. Slay the holder to take it.
The Cyrodiil Vampyrum Order, the Crimson Scars and the Bloodmist Clan open their doors to vampires.

sections.heading: Werewolves
items: A werewolf's bite can pass Sanies Lupinus; the same three days to cure it, then Hircine's Hunt decides your fate.
Beast Form four times a day, 150 seconds each. Feeding on a corpse in beast form adds 30 seconds.
Under a full moon at night, outdoors, the beast may take you against your will. Hircine's own, blessed at his shrine, are spared that.
Silver hurts. Anyone nearby sees you change.
Hircine's Pack of the Jerall: its leader wears the pale coat, and a packmate who brings the leader down in beast form takes the pack.

sections.heading: Cures and rites
items: Touch a shrine and say /rite: Molag Bal and Hircine give their gifts, Arkay and Stendarr lift a curse for a filled black soul gem.
You cannot be both. Each curse ends the other.

sections.heading: Holds and parties
items: Holds have Guards and a Guard Captain; strongholds a Stronghold Guard and a Stronghold Guard Commander. Hold factions are led by their Jarl, Bruma by its Count.
A party holds 6. Past that it becomes a raid of up to 12, and skill gain is halved for everyone in it.
Party leaders can remove members from the X menu.

sections.heading: Letters
items: Notice boards have a Letters tab. Read your pigeon letters there, and burn the ones you do not want.
A sealed letter now floats over nearby notice boards while you have unread mail.
Letters no longer flash across your screen or pour into chat.

sections.heading: Beast forms
items: Werewolf Beast Form works: cast it to take the form for 150 seconds.
Vampire Lords can take their form and cast Revert Form to return.
Death or logging out always returns you to your own body.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Fixed the missing Engine Fixes file that stopped the game from starting after a fresh install or repair.
Your gear goes back on right after you log in instead of 12 seconds later.
Turning back at a dungeon entrance no longer leaves you stuck in a loading state.
New /unstuck command: return to your area's respawn point once every 25 minutes. It cannot be used during a fight with another player.
Carry has been removed from the player menu.
The STATS window shows who is online now and today's peak.
Races of the Realm ranks every race by how many characters play it.
See how much gold players hold, carried and in their house storage.
Only real player characters count: NPCs, unfinished and fallen characters are left out, and deleted characters drop off.
The stats refresh every minute.

title: Factions Have Arrived
body: Tamriel's great powers are open for membership. Press F3 to see your factions, who is in them and who is online.

sections.heading: Factions
items: 46 factions: every Hold, the County of Bruma, the Orc strongholds, the great guilds and orders, and a secret cult for each Daedric Prince.
Each faction uses its own lore titles, from Apprentice to Arch-Mage.
Invite players from the F3 menu, or press X on a player and pick Invite.
Leaders set ranks and pass leadership on. Officers can remove lower ranks, and Sergeants can recruit.
Up to 3 Blacksmiths and 3 Tailors per faction. Faction gear crafting comes later.
Secret factions hide their members from outsiders.

sections.heading: Offices
items: Jarls, Counts and Barons can each appoint 2 Court Mages.
Chieftains appoint a Shaman and a Wise-Woman.
The launcher is now called DragonBreak Launcher. Your settings and sign-in carry over.
Patch notes like these now appear here after every update.
Default keys no longer clash: Factions F3, free cursor F8, hide UI F2, housing X.
The Discord button opens the DragonBreak Online server.

sections.heading: World
items: New characters no longer land stuck in Riverwood.
Wildlife no longer spawns in spots creatures cannot walk, such as the Pale Pass wolves.
Dungeons now scale to your party's size and highest level.
Dungeon loot now includes food, and bodies carry less gold.

sections.heading: Combat and characters
items: Concentration spells such as Sparks deal damage once per second per target.
Racial abilities such as Nord frost resistance no longer linger after they end.
Character creation shows RaceMenu's sliders again.

sections.heading: Interface
items: The party list shows the right distance for each member.
Names and titles above players are spaced properly.
Chat no longer steals focus while a menu is open, so Tab and menus no longer get stuck.
Pigeon letters wait for you at any notice board.
Stewards and Banes can be appointed, up to 5 each.

title: Your Launcher Keeps Itself Current
body: The launcher now downloads DragonBreak's own plugins, archives and assets, and fetches only the files that changed. No manual installs after an update.
